complete_campaign_supplied_statement: Everyone deserves a safe and stable place to live, health- care, quality education, fair pay, and secure retirement. Our children deserve clean water and a safe climate. I have spent 20 years side-by-side with family farmers, tenants, migrant farmworkers, Indigenous Peoples, and small town heroes, taking on the most powerful corporations, Wall Street banks, and big polluters to make life better for working people. My campaign is taking a stand with Oregonians from across our district to win real change. #NotMeUs. I am the only candidate who: • Has never taken a dime from the fossil fuel industry, big pharma, health insurance, big timber, or any corporate lobbyists. • • Has never supported the Jordan Cove Pipeline Project. Has never voted with Republicans to support the Administration’s white nationalist anti-immigrant agenda. In Congress, I will: • Combat climate change, invest in rural Oregon, and bring locally made clean energy here. • Promote affordable housing and fair wages so families can thrive. • Champion Medicare for All to cover us all, including mental health and addiction treatment. • Push for a fair immigration process that keeps families together, honors our values, and respects human rights. • Lead the movement to end the Forever Wars and take care of our veterans. • Advocate for debt-free education, affordable childcare, universal preschool, and paying our teachers. • Bring fairness to our criminal justice system and decrimi- nalize cannabis nationally. • Ensure billionaires and big corporations contribute their fair share. Endorsements National: Common Defense, Climate Hawks Vote, 350-Action, Brand New Congress. Local: 350 Eugene Climate Emergency PAC, Sunrise Movement Eugene & Corvallis, Graduate Teaching Fellows Federation (AFT Local 3544), Rural Oregon Progressives, Our Revolution Corvallis Allies, Our Revolution Lane County, Douglas County PARCs, UO Climate Justice League. Please visit www.CanningforCongress.com for updated endorsements and more. Facebook: @CanningforCongress Twitter: @Canning4Oregon Instagram: @CanningforCongress

complete_campaign_supplied_statement: PETER DEFAZIO: TAKING THEM ON Peter DeFazio is fighting for us and taking our fight to the Trump administration, greedy corporations, and special interests at every opportunity. Holding Corporations Accountable As Chair of the House Transportation and Infrastructure Committee, DeFazio is holding Boeing accountable for their devastating decisions that put profits above people’s lives. His investigation uncovered problems at Boeing and the FAA, and he is reforming the aircraft certification system to ensure public safety. Standing Up For the Right to Choose and Health Care DeFazio stands up for reproductive freedom and is the only candidate in this race endorsed by Planned Parenthood PAC and NARAL Pro-Choice America. He is pushing back at greedy pharmaceutical and insurance corporations to ensure that everyone has access to quality health care. Government Corruption DeFazio is holding the administration accountable and addressing abuses of power at the highest levels of our government. Taking On Climate Change Now Peter DeFazio is standing up to climate change deniers and those who want to sell our environment to the highest bidder. DeFazio is an original-cosponsor of the Green New Deal and believes we have a moral responsibility to take action to protect our environment. He released a transformative 21st century transportation plan to electrify our highways, transition our country to a fossil-fuel free future, and create millions of high-paying jobs. DeFazio fought for our environment, protecting 30,000 acres of old growth forest, 250 miles of wild and scenic rivers, and 100,000 acres of salmon and steelhead habitat. DeFazio is endorsed by (partial list): Planned Parenthood Action Fund League of Conservation Voters Action Fund Oregon Education Association Oregon AFL-CIO Oregon Working Families Party NARAL Pro-Choice America American Federation of Teachers-Oregon Young Democrats of Oregon Joint Council of Teamsters #37 United Food and Commercial Workers Union #555 For more: defazioforcongress.org

complete_campaign_supplied_statement: Oregon, America, moving forward My name is Blair Reynolds, an entrepreneur, veteran, and family man, and I am ready to represent you in Congress. I am running because I am done watching our democracy crumble in front of our eyes, torn apart by cravings for power. Our Congress would rather grandstand for soundbites than put the work in to pass legislation. Progressive change is seen as outlandish, while our national values are pulled further into Conservatism. We have been seeing the same struggles between Democratic centrists and Republican conservatives happen- ing for too many decades. Our country needs to move for- ward, and prepare for the future. A future where your value and right to livelihood isn't determined by your employer. I am running for everday people, with a platform of three basic principles. Universal Basic Income: $1,000 for every American over 18 every month. This will lift the floor of poverty, help families pay for unexpected expenses, help launch small businesses, and truly give Americans what we cherish most, freedom. Universal Health Care: We are tied to our employers whims, and insurance agencies that determine whether our medi- cal maladies are covered. Even the well-insured can find themselves bankrupted when insurance doesn't cover emergencies that happened out of network. The very nature of insurance is to reduce risk for their business. We need healthcare. For all. NOW. Democractic Reforms: Our incumbents stay in power with corporate PAC funding, corrupt parties, and voter supression. I would champion legislation to require mail-in paper ballots nationwide, and work to dismantle the big money two party system from the inner workings of the House and Senate. I am not a career politican backed by Big Pharma and Corporate PACs, I am a man determined to make this country a better place for all, for YOU. This is the way, forward.
